interpretations: Classful view: 255.255.255.0 is a class C mask, historically fixed at /24 → /24.
Host-bits view: 8 zero bits = 8 host bits, which under a mistaken reading gives /8; that option is absent and /24 stays correct.
reason: All three readings converge on /24; /16, /25 and /33 are respectively 255.255.0.0, 255.255.255.128 and outside the valid /0../32 range.
